title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00002 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 03:00: Spotted equipment on pipedeck according to spotting plan. Checked and and verified all equipment recieved.
03:00 - 07:00: Prepared hoses and cables for hookup of surface equipment.
07:00 - 07:30: Held pre-job meeting with day crew.
07:30 - 09:00: Continued to prepare equipment prior to rig up.
09:00 - 12:00: Started to verify equipment according to maersk checklist for hookup to rig.
12:00 - 13:30: Lifted grease injection head and toolcatcher to drillfloor. Fed cable through GIH.
13:30 - 16:00: Maersk electrician connected power to altus and SLB units. Meanwhile, lifted PCE equipment to drillfloor.
16:00 - 16:30: Held toolbox talk with involved personell prior to start building riser.
16:30 - 19:00: Built riser and lubricator section on catwalk using tugger. Meanwhile, finalized and function tested WL winch. Schlumberger built cable head.
19:00 - 23:45: Schlumberger tested primary BHA. Meanwhile, leak tested BOP on stump to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Function tested BOP rams.
23:45 - 00:00: Production department started to close in well for handover.
